verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents automatic follow-up reminders: "If your email needs a response, you're automatically reminded to follow up" with a draft ready, and the Email Assistant "keeps every follow-up on track." Via MCP it can check which emails were read and draft nudges. Nothing in the pack documents snoozing conversations, and the reminder docs do not clearly describe a thread resurfacing in the inbox when nobody replies. missing for 10: any evidence of a snooze capability, explicit documentation that unreplied threads resurface, configurable reminder timing, independent or hands-on corroboration
